text:
maya (PM): quick thread: we need a concrete launch checklist for private deploys focused on three asks: pinned egress, offline installer, and predictable rollback behavior.

raj (Eng): core tradeoffs: egress pinning via controller is doable; cross-operator rewrites break guarantees. operator-shim buys determinism but is extra scope.

owen (Infra): propose two paths: lightweight controller (standard) + operator-shim for enterprise customers (opt-in). shim handles bind/rebind and exposes a graceful-failure API.

tess (Eng-Ops): shim prototype plan: proof-of-concept by mid-Q2, tests for minor upgrade rebind path and chaos injection.

noah (Security): offline installs must support signed bundles and a verification step. also KMS/HSM contract needs to spell out key residency and audit trails.

lina (Solutions): field: customers want a UI knob for allowed-egress CIDRs and a one-shot installer mode that never calls home. sample config below.

maya (PM): suggested MVP launch criteria: 1) documented best-effort egress pinning for minor upgrades 2) offline/signed bundle installer 3) telemetry opt-in with local export 4) rollback playbook targeting sub-4hr for minor patches (enterprise shim lowers risk).

raj (Eng): +1. action items: - shim design doc (raj/tess) - offline-installer flags + signing (owen/raj) - KMS draft + legal loop (noah/lina) - rollback SLA draft + runbooks (maya).

deploy-bot: created RED-3456 "operator-shim prototype" assigned to raj.

maya (PM): deadlines: shim doc by 2025-04-18, installer PR by 2025-04-25, KMS draft by 2025-05-02, SLA baseline by 2025-05-09. I'll update roadmap and reach out to legal.

owen (Infra): will add perf tests; expect control-plane overhead small (~<2%).

raj (Eng): I'll share the RFC link when ready. thanks everyone.
